title: Ready-to-move rate-and-term refinance
scenario: Paul and his wife already decided to refinance and Paul calls back to get moving. He asks about documents, appraisal and closing timeline; the rep stays compliant on payment questions.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Copperleaf Home Loans, this is Lauren.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hi Lauren, it's Paul. We spoke last week about refinancing. My wife and I talked it over and we want to go ahead.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great to hear from you, Paul. Glad you two had a chance to talk.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, we went back and forth, but we're in. So what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Let's start the application. I'll need your current mortgage statement, two recent pay stubs for each of you, and your last two years of W-2s.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Easy. My wife's a teacher, so hers are pretty simple. Mine might be messier, I get quarterly bonuses.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's fine, we'll just want your year-end pay stub or the bonus history so it's documented.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. Will you need to do an appraisal?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Most likely yes, though occasionally it can be waived depending on the loan. We'll know once the application's in.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Got it. And how long does the whole thing usually take, start to finish?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Typically somewhere around thirty to forty-five days, depending mostly on the appraisal scheduling and how fast documents come in.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. And what will my new payment end up being?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I want to give you a real number, not a guess, so I'll have that in your official loan estimate once we pull credit and verify everything. You'll get it in writing within a few days of applying.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Fair enough.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: By the way, how was the anniversary trip? You mentioned you were heading up to the lake.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, it was great. Cold, but great. We didn't catch a single fish.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, that's still a good trip. Okay, I'll send the application link to both of your emails. Would you rather go through it together tonight, or should I walk you through it tomorrow at lunch?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Tomorrow at lunch, if that works. Then we can both ask questions.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Tomorrow at twelve-fifteen. Talk to you both then.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thanks Lauren.
